notes:
- Your material can now be bigger than your machine, up to 3 m on a side. You can open a big design and add space to it. To burn it, it still has to fit your machine's work area, which is drawn on the material.
- Fixed: saving a design forgot the size of your material, so it came back on the whole work area.
- Keep proportions, under Width and Height: type a new width and the height changes to match, and the other way round. It is on until you turn it off.
- Report a problem, in the ? menu: it saves a report on your Desktop and opens an email to Kevin, ready for you to attach it.
- If AbsoDoodley closes unexpectedly, it offers to report it the next time it starts.
- The tester guide shows how to set the size of your board.
